name: cicy-agent
title: Cicy Agent
description: Operate local and Cloud Agents, discover this Instance's team ID and fixed domain, and coordinate work with tracked messages and completion notifications.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Cicy Agent (tmux)
zh-CN.description: 操作本地 Agent，并通过 CiCy Cloud 自动发现和消息路由访问其他 Instance；无需目标 Token。

tools.name: tmux list
tools.description: List all tmux panes and windows

tools.name: tmux send
tools.description: Send keys to a tmux pane

tools.name: tmux msg
tools.description: Send a local or Cloud message. Prints msg_id immediately and waits for structured done/failed reply by default; --no-wait returns after acceptance; callbacks never scrape capture.

tools.name: agent msgs
tools.description: List the cross-agent message link: who→who, status (sent|done|failed), and a q⟶answer summary of what the receiver actually did (JOINed from history).

tools.name: broadcast
tools.description: Group-send a message to ONLINE agents only (offline cannot receive; no --all). Per-send timeout so dead panes cannot stall; prints delivered/failed stats; skips the sender.

tools.name: agents online/offline/all
tools.description: Roster by liveness: get_online/offline/all_agents. Rows: id, title, agent_type, online, model, provider, local_gateway, context_usage, cost, idle. Runtime fields show n/a when unavailable.

tools.name: create
tools.description: Create a BRAND-NEW agent from scratch (POST /api/panes/create); agent_type defaults to cicy. Not a clone — use fork to inherit an existing agent's context.

tools.name: instance identity
tools.description: Return this Agent ID, team ID, Instance ID, fixed proxy host, and HTTPS URL from the authenticated Cloud directory.
